repos_data.description: ~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.

Open-source autonomous AI penetration testing. 50 specialist agents across web, API, cloud, Active Directory, Kubernetes, CI/CD and AI/LLM (OWASP LLM Top 10). Runs on a local LLM behind a Privacy Gateway. Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, VS Code, JetBrains, n8n, Grafana & Splunk.
Sudoless Apple Silicon system monitor (native SwiftUI GUI) with ANE / Media Engine / memory-bandwidth tracking

Nornicdb is a distributed low-latency, Graph+Vector, Temporal MVCC with all sub-ms HNSW search, graph traversal, and writes. Using Neo4j Bolt/Cypher and qdrant's gRPC means you can switch with no changes while adding intelligent features like schemas, managed embeddings, reranking+llm, GPU accel, Auto-TLP, Policy-based Memory Decay, and MCP server.
Local coding agent with neat UI

Kubernetes operator for self-hosted LLM inference across a heterogeneous GPU fleet: NVIDIA CUDA, AMD Vulkan, and Apple Silicon Metal. Runtimes: llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, mlx-server. Multi-GPU sharding, model caching, OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Apache-2.0, run across homelab and on-prem fleets, actively developed.
M-Courtyard: Local AI Model Fine-tuning Assistant for Apple Silicon. Zero-code, zero-cloud, privacy-first desktop app powered by Tauri + React + mlx-lm.
🤖 Visual AI agent workflow automation platform with local LLM integration - build intelligent workflows using drag-and-drop interface, no cloud dependencies required.

Your private, on-device personal AI assistant for macOS and Windows. Chat, create, search files, and connect tools with local models. Includes an OpenAI-compatible API. Opt-in Pro sees, remembers, reflects, and acts with your approval. No cloud or account.

Your personal context engine for macOS, with Windows and Linux in alpha: on-device meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, and autocomplete that you and your AI agents can search. Free and open source (GPLv3).

The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.
Free, open-source AI autocomplete for macOS — on-device ghost-text suggestions in every app. A private, local Cotypist alternative built with MLX.
MCP server for Git with local Ollama — zero tokens for git operations
Native macOS workspace for Apple's container runtime. Browse, run, build and clean up Linux containers with live resource gauges, a built-in terminal and a local MLX chat playground.

Grux AI: open source AI agent for macOS (MIT). One Command Panel for your mail, calendar, meetings, files and a shell it can undo. Runs on a local Ollama model with no key, or your own key. Change it with Claude Code. Download Grux.dmg at gruxai.com, or brew install --cask dotcomjack/tap/grux

Run the native 284B-A13B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 LLM locally on one laptop CPU: pure C, 8 GB RAM minimum, no GPU, best TPOT 0.892 s/token, resident OpenAI-compatible API with function tools. | 在笔记本单颗 CPU 上本地运行原生 284B-A13B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 大模型：纯 C，最低 8 GB 内存，无需 GPU，最优 TPOT 0.892 秒/token，支持模型常驻的 OpenAI 兼容接口与函数工具。
LLMxRay — Local LLM Observatory. Full observability interface for Ollama: chat, streaming, reasoning, RAG, introspection, metrics.

Qwen3.8-27B on one laptop CPU: up to 2.52 token/s, 8 GB tested, no runtime accuracy loss. Native OpenAI-compatible API with function tools; no GPU or Python. | 单颗笔记本 CPU 运行 Qwen3.8-27B：最快 2.52 token/s，最低 8 GB 内存可运行，推理加速不牺牲准确性。原生 OpenAI 兼容接口支持函数工具；无需 GPU 或 Python。

localaik is a local compatibility server for a subset of the Gemini and OpenAI APIs. Run one container locally, point your SDK to it, and the proxy serves both protocol shapes on the same port for tests and development.
macOS GUI for llama.cpp — run local GGUF models and download them with resume that survives a kill
Local AI search for files you can't find.
Local MCP server exposing the Cloudflare Clef-Flash decision model to AI agents — structured decisions with probability outputs, fully offline via llama.cpp.
Spend tokens on judgment, not typing. An MCP-native autonomous SDLC pipeline: frontier models plan and review, local models implement — engineering discipline on a $20/month budget.
MCP server that offloads cheap work from your cloud LLM agent to a local Ollama model — summaries, drafts, extractions, first-pass reviews — at zero cloud cost.
Menu-bar panel for local LLM engines on macOS: run Splash or llama.cpp, watch memory and speed, get models from Hugging Face
Local AI models on your Mac, one click from your tools. A menu bar app for GGUF and MLX on Apple silicon.
Local-first CLI and MCP server for meeting transcription, summarization, and provenance — reference implementation of the memnex specification.
Local-first document corpus pipeline for grounded AI agents
Grounder MCP - live web search, fetch, deep_search evidence packs, and agentic research for local & cloud LLMs. Thin client for grounder.dev.
Deep Research infrastructure for AI agents.
